reasoning: The kernel equations reduce to 3x+y-z=0 and 6y+12z=0, giving y=-2z and x=z. Thus the kernel consists of all vectors (z,-2z,z). The earlier answer c was graded Correct and agrees with Math Academy's worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence: Therefore, the kernel of the linear transformation $\,T$ is $\{[\begin{aligned}z \\ -2z \\ z\end{aligned}]\,:\,z\in R\}.$
